tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chos spyod gtor ma'i rim pa kun dga'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// kun khyab thugs rje'i pha rol mu med du// spros pa me zhal rdzing ring gcig pu las// gzhan pa'i gzugs zla bskal par rnyed min pa// bla ma phyag na pad+mas dge legs stsol// sgo gsum dge bar sbyor ba'i g.yar dam khur// rnam g.yeng lam du re re nas stor bas// tha mar dge zong zad pa'i shugs ring dbugs// 'byin la stong pa'i mkha' yang gad mo bro// gang phyir mchod sbyin rgyas pa'i rnga bo che// 'bad rtsol dbyu gus bskul ba ma bzod skabs// 'ga' zhig blor 'tsham dbyangs can tam+bu raḥ /myur mgyogs lag pa'i phang par brdung ba snyan// de'ang chos spyod gtor ma'i rim pa nyams su bstar ba 'dod pas sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las sbyor ba la/ spyi'i mchod pa nyer spyod dang*/ dzam+bha la la snod du dzaṃ gtor dang chu sbyin pa'i snod bcas/ brgya rtsa dngos la gtor zan dkar gsum sogs sbags pa sum tshan gsum dang nyis tshan gcig gis brgya rtsa brgyad byas pa bcu tshan bcu dang brgyad du bgos la/ snod bcu gcig gam lnga la sogs par chu dang bcas pa bsham/ gzhan yang bar do'i gtor ma dang dbyu gu la zan ril grangs mthun sogs gang 'os kyi rdzas rnams nyer bsdogs bya'o// dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed pa/ mgron spyan 'dren pa/ mchod sbyin stob pa ste gsum las/ thog mar mchod pa byin rlabs byas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar bya ba'am/ min na/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba byang chub bar// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// gzhan don rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bya'i phyir// sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i lam la 'jug par bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/ chos kun stong pa'i dbyings las pad+ma zlar// rang sems hrīḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// dkar 'dzum mchog sbyin pad+ma bsnams pa can// lang tsho dar bab dar dang rin chen brgyan// sems dpa'i skyil mo krung bzhugs thugs ka'i hrīḥ

/'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas rang 'dra dang*// dbang gi lhar bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis// badz+rī bha wa hūm̐ gis chu dbang bskur// pad+ma'i rigs kyi bla mas spyi bor brgyan// thugs kar hrīḥyig sngags kyis bskor ba las// 'od 'phros 'gro ba drug gi sdig sgrib sbyangs// zhes bsam zhing oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes 'bru drug cung zad bzla'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma'i mgron du gtogs pa thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ ting shag brdung zhing*/ kye rnam gsum sdom pa'i dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam rgyal ba sras slob rkyen gcig rtogs// dam can rgya mtsho lha srin sde tshogs brgyad// rigs drug sems can bgegs rigs lan chags rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma'i mgron du gnyer byed na// thogs med 'dir gshegs 'os pa'i gdan la bzhugs// zhes spyan drangs nas gdan 'bul/ gsum pa ni/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐ gi bar gyis nyer spyod dang*/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs kyis bshos 'bul lo// dzam+bha lar chu sbyin pa ni/ mdun du pad+ma zla bar skad cig las// rmugs 'dzin ser po pī dza pū ra dang*// na ku la bsnams rin chen phreng bas spras// dung dkar pad+ma'i gter la rol stabs bzhugs// g.yon du rmugs 'dzin mthing gi mi'u thung gzugs// thod pa nor bu skyugs pa'i ne'u le bsnams// ral pa gyen brdzes klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan// nor bdag gdan la g.yas brkyang stabs su bzhengs// bdag gi lag mthil rigs lnga zhu ba'i chu// chal chil 'bab pa 'thungs pas dgyes shing tshim// ser po la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa dang nag po la oṃ in+d+ra ni mu khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swā hā/

lan gsum/ oṃ dzaluṃ swā hā zhes pa brgya rtsas chu 'bul/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis gnyis ka la 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nor gyi dbang phyug sogs sh+lau kas bstod/ sar+b+ba sid+dhi pha la hoḥzhes dngos grub zhu'o// brgya rtsa dngos la zan ril bcu tshan dang po chus sbyangs te/ sngags gnyis kyis bsang sbyangs/ rin chen gtor snod yangs par oṃ yig las// gtor ma 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// zhes dang*/ 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir bsam/ na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐ zhes nyer gcig gis bsngo/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ bar gyis mchod/ ting shag dang*/ gtor ma 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// bla ma rgyal ba sras slob bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas yon sbyor bdag dang sems can la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// gnyis pa nas bzhi pa yan la 'bru gsum dang sngags dang mchod pa dang tshig rkang dang po rnams sngar bzhin la/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtshor 'bul// bzhes nas bstan 'dzin mchod yon bar chad sel// dam chos bshad sgrub rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// gsum pa la/ rig 'dzin dge sbyong bden par smra la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag sogs yid la brnag pa'i don// tshegs med 'grub pa'i smon lam gdab tu gsol// bzhi pa la/ lhan skyes phan 'dogs nor lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas tshe dang bsod nams sde bzhi'i dpal// dbyar mtsho lta bur 'phel ba'i dpung gnyen mdzod// lnga pa man chad la 'bru gsum lan gsum dang*/ sngags bdun bdun dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan spyi ltar ram/ mi nus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang gzugs dam pa sku 'byam klas 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa dang*/

tshig rkang dang po rnams 'dra bar byas la/ gzhi bdag yul lha gnas bdag kun la stobs// dus su char 'bebs rtsi shing lo phyugs legs// 'jig rten khams kyi bde dga' rgyas par mdzod// drug pa la/ gnod sbyin sde dpung 'phrog mar bcas la sbyin// bdag gzhan gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor ring spangs nas// mi zad dbyig gi dngos grub char du phobs// bdun pa la/ gdon bgegs nad bdag pho mo'i rigs la sbyin// phyin chad bsam ngan gdug rtsub mi gtong zhing*// gzhan phan sems mchog rgyud la skye gyur cig /brgyad pa la/ mkha' mnyam rigs drug sems can yongs la sbyin// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas bral te// bde mchog sangs rgyas sa la phyin gyur cig /dgu pa la/ kha 'bar mas mtshon yi dwags gtogs par sbyin// zas skom bdud rtsir spyod pa'i skal ba ldan// ser sna'i sgrib byang rnam mkhyen thob par shog /bcu pa la/ sngon rabs lan chags sha gnyer rnams la sbyin// lan chags bu lon khyer zhing byang ba dang*// re ba rdzogs pa'i dga' bder spyod gyur cig /bcu gcig pa la/ ma thob ma slebs lhag sdud rnams la sbyin// bza' btung ci 'dod skal ba legs thob ste// nges legs lam dang 'bras bur smin gyur cig /ces mgron tshan bcu gcig ste 'di la brten nas stong rtsa'am 'bum ther sogs kyang sngar bzhin bsag go /de bzhin du bar do'i gtor ma ni/ mi ring dus byas bar do'i 'gro la sbyin// 'khrul ngor snang ba'i 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal las// rnam grol longs spyod rdzogs sku mngon gyur cig /ces so// dbyu gu la gtong na 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir byas la/ oṃ a kā ro sogs drug cu rtsa bzhis bsngos la/ gtor ma 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// chu tshod rdo rje lha mo drug cu bzhir// 'bul gyi bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor du bcas// dus kyi bar chad srung ba'i phrin las sgrubs// zhes dang*/

brul gtor gtong bar 'dod na gzhan du 'byung ba ltar 'dir 'jug go /chos sbyin ni 'jig rten pa spyi la/ ye dharmā dang sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs nas 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye zhes bshad do// chu sbyin ni chu gtsang 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang nyid 'phags par gsal ba'i mchog sbyin phyag rgya las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun kha 'bar ma la sogs pa'i yi dwags rnams kyis 'thungs shing longs spyod par bsams la chu sbyin zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ dza la mi daṃ sar+b+ba bre te bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes pa bdun gyis bsngos la/ thugs rje che ldan spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /mchog sbyin phyag las babs pa 'o ma'i rgyun// yi dwags rnams kyis 'thungs shing khrus byas pas// lha lus lta bu'i bde ba ldan gyur cig /ces dang*/ yi dwags sogs ngan 'gro thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyong bar bsams la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ sogs dang*/ oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te/ na mas+sa man+ta sha s+pha ra ṇa rasmi saṃ bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi/ du ru du ru hri da ya dza la ni swā hā zhes dang*/ yan lag brgyad ldan chu yi sbyin par brten// dga' bo nye dga' la sogs chu bdag rnams// dpag yas sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs nas// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas thob shog /thams cad thun mong du bden pa'i stobs brjod pas thob par byed pa ni/ bslu med skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum// nges pa'i 'phrin yig srid pa gsum gsal ba'i// bden pa de yis khyed cag 'dod pa'i dpal// gegs med 'byung zhing rang dbang spyod gyur cig /ces brjod do// rjes la/ nongs pa bzod cing gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ bkra shis bsngo bas mtha' brgyan pa/ phan yon mdor bstan pa ste/ gsum gyi/ dang po la/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ mchod rdzas dman dang bying rgod dbang gyur sogs// nyes pa gang lags dmigs med dbyings brtul nas// ye shes 'jig rten mgron rnams 'dzum dmul gyis// rang rang gnas su gshegs par mdzod cig kye// oṃ badz+ra muḥ

sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ sarba pre ta gats+tsha zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis dang*/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan sbyin pa bzhi'i// mchog sbyin phyag gi yal ga rtag rkyong ba// rnam pa thams cad gzigs pa'i dpag bsam shing*// yon tan snye mas dud pa nyid gyur cig /ces dang*/ gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam gang rigs brjod par bya'o// gsum pa/ de ltar gtor ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson par byas pas/ tshe 'di'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ gtor ma la re ba'i mi ma yin pa rnams kyis bdag la byams shing rtag tu bsrung ba dang*/ gtor ma la sbyin pa bzhi tshang bas dbul ba 'dor ba'i nor sgrub kyi mchog yin pa dang*/ mthar thug sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pas bsod nams brgya pa'i gzugs sku 'grub pa sogs phan yon bka' dang bstan bcos rnams las rgya cher 'byung bas de dag tu gzigs pas yid ches par bya'o// smras pa/ sngon rabs mkhas pa'i zhal lung nyin mor byed// phul byung phyin rlabs 'od bkrag che na yang*// rgyun chags brtson chung mig gis ma bzod par// nyams blang bde ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par bdar// rgyu tshegs phra mo yis kyang 'khor 'das mgron// dgyes bskyed bzod pa'i mtshar la blta ba'i ched// yid 'phrog dri za'i bu mo snyan ngag glur// len pa'i zol gyis 'di na lhags sam snyam// 'di bgyis dge bas yang 'byung thams cad du// sems can khams su gtsug lag rab 'byams chos// snang byed gtam gyi 'bab stegs zlos pa'i gar// bsgyur la gzhar yang ngal ba ma gyur cig /ces chos spyod gtor ma'i rim pa kun dga'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku bstan 'dzin mchog grub pa'i bkas rgyun chags nyams su blang bde'i ched du tshigs bcad pa zhig dgos zhes stsal ba'i ngor/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan dang thar rtse mkhas pa sogs kyi gsung don brjod byar byas te ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/

rab byung 'dod pa'i na tshod ldan gyi gnam lo'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis par chos sde'i gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba'i nye logs dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
